visualDirection.style: tactile handmade-paper collage with soft clay edges and a curious cloud mascot
visualDirection.semanticRule: Images provide surface, object, and mood only; all copy, amounts, dates, state claims, and AI conclusions stay in live DOM/UI.

interactionScope.motionOwner: CSS/React owns spring, breathing, coin bounce, number interpolation, sheet entrance, and confetti particles.
interactionScope.contentOwner: DOM owns labels, step text, form values, daily allowance, AI copy, validation, and accessibility semantics.

assets.meaning: A warm floating orb with a small cloud mascot peeking over a blank speech bubble; it invites setup without asserting a result.
assets.integration: Render as an inside a 44px+ hit-area button; keep the bubble copy as live DOM text positioned over the blank bubble. Hide the whole entry when fixedCapital.enabled is true.
assets.recommendedDisplay: orb 72–96px; bubble copy 11–13px; bottom-right above navigation safe area
assets.generationPromptSummary: Transparent tactile cloud-orb, blank speech bubble, no text, no numbers, no currency symbols.

assets.meaning: A cream stitched paper sheet with three blank inset wells for income, fixed expenses, and savings target.
assets.integration: Use as a decorative plate behind real inputs. Overlay the two-step header, labels, values, validation, primary action, and close control in DOM; crop/scale with object-fit: contain rather than using as a full-screen background.
assets.recommendedDisplay: sheet width min(100%, 520px); keep 16–24px padding from the live input wells
assets.generationPromptSummary: Transparent tactile bottom-sheet plate with three blank input wells, no labels or copy.

assets.meaning: A 45-degree isometric gold coin with a blank cream face and a blank ticket plaque reserved for a live daily allowance.
assets.integration: Place inside a semantic button or badge wrapper. Render the live daily amount beside/over the blank plaque. Use transform/scale for tap bounce and avoid raster frame swapping for continuous motion.
assets.recommendedDisplay: coin 48–96px on compact home header; preserve transparent padding for the 45-degree silhouette
assets.generationPromptSummary: Transparent 45-degree tactile gold coin with blank face and blank ticket plaque, no symbols or copy.

assets.meaning: A blank ruled-paper card with a cloud mascot peeking over it, suitable for an AI analysis pre-result or neutral loading shell.
assets.integration: Use as a quiet visual layer while the real AI response, error, retry, and allowance values render in DOM. A breathing cloud can be animated with CSS; do not imply that analysis has completed until the actual response state says so.
assets.recommendedDisplay: card max-width 420px; keep ruled area clear for readable live copy
assets.generationPromptSummary: Transparent tactile blank ledger card with cloud peeking over top edge, no conclusion, no text.

vectorAssets.meaning: Neutral decorative sparkle/confetti pieces with no semantic state claim.
vectorAssets.integration: Clone or use as a masked decorative particle; keep particle count, timing, and reduced-motion behavior in CSS/React.

vectorAssets.meaning: Small tactile cream-gold handle that makes the sheet affordance discoverable.
vectorAssets.integration: Place inside a real 44px+ drag handle button; the SVG is decoration only and must not own the close action.

validation.webDerivatives: mechanical RGBA downscales; no visual reinterpretation
validation.nextGate: Mount each candidate in a real 390px and 320px flow, check safe-area overlap, contrast of DOM text over the blank wells, and verify the orb is hidden after fixedCapital activation before promoting to candidates-v4/public.
